review: Host opt-in precedes binding and cache cursor dispatch requires selected cached fields.
All thirteen qualified cached scalar/Memo kinds retain existing storage carriers and validation.
Ordinary and zero-width projections retain payload pruning; selected corruption and EOF failures remain explicit.
Progressive reads never promote a complete snapshot cache, including after a successful prefix.
CLI retains complete TSV batches only, and never executes stored formulas.
test_corrections: First CLI batch exposed missing with_stored_calculations initialization in the separate stream host; added explicit flag application before binding. Initial failed log is excluded from accepted counts.
boundaries: Stored results may be stale; no formula execution or freshness qualification.
Existing ACE 16-family cached storage gates remain unchanged.
Stable/offline input only; no coherent live shared-file guarantee.
